title: Claude crossing-gun pose repair, tools 64-67
rejection_reason: User review found the shoulder-to-elbow arm connections incorrect: both arms must cross in front of the chest, with the left-hand gun pointing toward the character's upper right and the right-hand gun toward the character's lower left. Matching grip positions and height alone did not reproduce the pose.
notes: First frame is purposeful fast-turn smear. Settled frames share one base drawing and follow the original's small hand variations. Head/sole height and actual game grip targets determine placement; no large automatic arm stretch. Only this clip is replaced. Not built into NPK or installed.
